environment.description: Same Step Functions workflow behind an internal ALB (scheme: internal, subnet: private). The ALB target group forwards to API Gateway VPC endpoint. ALB listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS authentication using a trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:XXXX:truststore/internal-ca-bundle/abc123) that references an ACM PCA subordinate CA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:XXXX:certificate-authority/org-internal-issuing-ca). Connection negotiation requires the client to present a certificate chaining to this private CA during TLS handshake. The trust store has revocation checking enabled via CRL (s3://pki-artifacts-internal/crl/issuing-ca.crl, refresh interval 60s). Only certificates with Subject OU=platform-services AND SAN DNS matching *.workflow-clients.internal.corp are accepted by the ALB listener's client certificate validation. No public DNS record exists for the ALB. Security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e allows inbound 443 only from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (service mesh sidecar egress range).
